page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is a general-purpose, high-frequency virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place the instance in the average tier across multiple categories. In CPU-intensive tasks, it achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1436.68 and a multi-core score of 30666.35, supported by hardware acceleration flags such as AVX-512 and AES cryptography. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1705.41 GB/sec, which drops to 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write bandwidth of 48.22 GB/sec. The instance demonstrates solid capabilities in specialized tasks, achieving 28.91 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and a static web serving throughput of 21.45 GB/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated physical core allocation provides predictable compute performance without hyperthreading overhead, making it a stable choice for workloads sensitive to CPU jitter. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs means users pay strictly for compute and memory resources, optimizing cost efficiency for workloads that utilize network-attached storage. This configuration is suitable for software compilation, database operations, web serving, and moderate-scale text or image processing.
